evals.expected_output: Measures the track's tempo, phase, downbeats and sections with beatgrid.py, cuts it on its own downbeats with segments anchored to the picture events, and checks every seam.

Cuts on downbeats, does not stretch to fit
Checks seams by listening or measurement
